purpose: Cross-account and cross-program relationship edges for the relationship-matrix Figma screen (concept-relationship-network, Account Portfolio Matrix). Seeds the SHARED_PROGRAM, SHARED_PRIME, PARENT_CHILD, and COMPETITOR_ON_PROGRAM edge types. SHARED_CONTACT edges are omitted from this seed because they must be derived from the contacts file at runtime; a query in the loader produces them from the contacts data automatically.

truth_rules.public_evidence_or_simulated: Each edge is either PUBLICLY_EVIDENCED (a public source establishes the connection) or SIMULATED_INFERRED (for the POC, a reasonable inference we deliberately mark as simulated per your directive that this may need to be simulated).
truth_rules.no_hidden_ties: Edges reflect only what is either publicly documented or explicitly marked as a POC simulation.
truth_rules.bidirectional_where_applicable: SHARED_PROGRAM and SHARED_PRIME are bidirectional; PARENT_CHILD and COMPETITOR_ON_PROGRAM are directional.

edge_types.SHARED_PROGRAM: Two accounts publicly participate in the same program (e.g. Boeing and Northrop both on NGAD teams).
edge_types.SHARED_PRIME: Two accounts both supply the same prime contractor (inferred / simulated because subcontractor rosters are typically not public).
edge_types.PARENT_CHILD: One account is a subsidiary, division, or acquisition of another.
edge_types.COMPETITOR_ON_PROGRAM: Two accounts competed for or on the same program (public bid competition).
edge_types.SHARED_CONTACT: One named contact appears at both accounts (career move, board seat, or subsidiary relationship). Derived at runtime from the contacts file.
edge_types.GEOGRAPHIC_CLUSTER: Two accounts operate in the same geographic manufacturing corridor (e.g. Boeing STL + Spirit ICT).
